title: Senior Cross-Platform UI Developer
description:
Job Title
 



**Senior Cross\-Platform UI Developer** 




  





 Location
 



 On\-site – Jaipur or Gandhinagar
 



  





 Experience
 



 4 to 6 years
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer with strong expertise in either
 **Flutter** 
 or
 **Angular** 
 , along with solid working knowledge of the other. You will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, high\-performance mobile and web applications using modern architectural patterns and best practices.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to work across platforms while anchoring one as your core strength, contributing to robust, reusable, and maintainable codebases.
 



  





 Key ResponsibilitiesIf Flutter is Your Core Strength
 


* Architect and develop scalable Flutter applications using
 **BLoC** 
 ,
 **get\_it** 
 , and clean modular architecture.
* Maintain and optimise domain, data, and presentation layers.
* Write comprehensive
 **unit, widget, and integration tests** 
 .
* Implement and support
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 for automated testing and app releases.
* Collaborate on the Angular web codebase when required, following established standards and best practices.



 If Angular is Your Core Strength
 


* Build and maintain Angular
 **v17\+** 
 applications using
 **Standalone Components** 
 ,
 **NgRx Store/Effects** 
 ,
 **Signals** 
 , and
 **Bootstrap Grid** 
 .
* Design reusable components, services, and dynamic layouts.
* Manage application state and optimise performance across modules.
* Develop and maintain
 **unit and integration tests** 
 .
* Collaborate on the Flutter mobile codebase when required, adhering to application guidelines.



 Shared Responsibilities
 


* Work closely with designers, backend engineers, and QA teams to deliver high\-quality releases.
* Own features end\-to\-end, from design through development to production release.
* Participate actively in
 **code reviews** 
 , build processes, and CI/CD workflows.
* Ensure adherence to best practices in architecture, performance, security, and testing.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments in Flutter and Angular ecosystems.



 RequirementsMust\-Have
 


* Strong expertise in either
 **Flutter** 
 (BLoC, get\_it, architecture) or
 **Angular** 
 (v17\+, Standalone Components, NgRx, Signals).
* Working proficiency in the secondary stack with a willingness to deepen expertise.
* Solid understanding of
 **state management** 
 ,
 **testing** 
 , and
 **modular architecture** 
 .
* Experience with
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and release processes.
* Proficiency with
 **Git** 
 , code reviews, and agile development methodologies.



 Nice\-to\-Have
 


* Experience with
 **App Store** 
 and
 **Play Store** 
 deployments.
* Prior experience in
 **mentorship** 
 , technical leadership, or cross\-functional collaboration.
